=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. 5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.

records.system: You are one player in a game on the XColos platform, played by turns. You know only what the game tells you; other players' hidden information is hidden from you as yours is from them. Your goal is to win. records.prompt:
[user]
=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.

Think about the rules, the other players and what they have done, then act. When you are asked to act, reply with exactly one legal answer in the form the question asks for, and keep any reasoning short and before the answer. Do not ask questions back.

[user]
=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

Each round runs in this order: round begins → clear last round → talk → pick a hat → count choices → collect → colour results → results → value update → your standing → next round → after the last round.

                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.

A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:

5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:

[user]
=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

[user]
=== Ripening Hats ===

There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).

records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
There are 5 hat colours, in this fixed order: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple. Each colour has a public value, and all five start at 2. Each player is dealt a secret favourite colour at random, all different; only that player knows it. Every player has a private score starting at 0, which only that player can see.

The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round:
1. Everyone is told the round number and the current value of each of the 5 colours.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Talk binds no one.
3. Choice: everyone simultaneously and secretly chooses one of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple or Black.
4. Collection. A player who chose Black adds 1 to their score. A player who chose a colour that no other player chose this round collects it: they add that colour's current value to their score, plus 3 more if it is their favourite; if it is not their favourite, they add only the colour's value. A colour chosen by two or more players is contested, and none of them gains anything (0).
5. Everyone is told, without naming players: for each colour, whether it was COLLECTED (exactly one chooser), CONTESTED (two or more) or UNTOUCHED (no one), and how many players chose Black. Individual choices and scores are never announced.
6. Value update. Each colour that was collected this round resets to 1. Each colour that was contested or untouched gains +1, to a maximum of 7 (a colour at 7 stays there).

After round 12 the game ends and all favourites and scores are revealed. The player with the highest final score wins. If two or more players tie for the highest score, the game is a draw among them (they share the result).
